name: Guns N' Roses

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles hard-rock band formed in 1985. Appetite for Destruction (1987) brought street-blues riffs and Axl Rose’s scream to late-80s metal radio before grunge took over US rock charts.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶硬摇滚乐队，1985 年成立。Appetite for Destruction（1987）在 grunge 占榜前，把街头蓝调 riff 与 Axl Rose 的尖叫送上 80 年代末金属电台。

note.en: Appetite opener; street hard rock beside glossy hair-metal peers.
note.zh: Appetite 开场；相对光泽 hair-metal 同辈的街头 hard rock。

note.en: Slash hexatonic intro over a radio ballad form; hard second half.
note.zh: Slash 六声前奏压在电台谣曲形式上；后半仍重。

note.en: Use Your Illusion epic; piano and orchestra under hard-rock arrangement.
note.zh: Use Your Illusion 长曲；钢琴与管弦压在 hard-rock 编排下。

interviewQuotes.text: We were a real band from the street.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Slash

interviewQuotes.text: Appetite was recorded like a live wire. That's why it still cuts.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Axl Rose

interviewQuotes.text: We will not work together again unless one of us dies first. (Chinese-edition wording; not a verified English original.)
interviewQuotes.speaker: Axl Rose

lyricQuotes: Welcome to the jungle, we got fun and games
She's got a smile that it seems to me

shortBio.en: Classic five-piece hard rock; Sweet Child O’ Mine is the mass-radio ballad with a hard second half.
shortBio.zh: 经典五人 hard rock；Sweet Child O’ Mine 是后半仍重的大众电台谣曲。

body.en:
Formed in 1985. Appetite for Destruction paired Axl Rose’s scream, Slash’s Les Paul leads, Izzy Stradlin’s rhythm parts, Duff McKagan’s punk-leaning bass, and Steven Adler’s swing drums—against the glossy hair-metal sound of the same years. Use Your Illusion (1991) expanded longer pieces such as November Rain and coincided with lineup strain.

Welcome to the Jungle and Sweet Child O’ Mine (1987) are the dual entry points. They mark a late commercial peak for hard rock on US radio immediately before alternative rock redraws the same market.

Rose (William Bailey) and Stradlin (Jeffrey Isbell) moved from Indiana to Los Angeles in 1982. The first chairs were Tracii Guns, Ole Beich, and Rob Gardner, then Slash, Duff McKagan, and Steven Adler. The five first played in June 1985. A&R Tom Zutaut, also tied to Mötley Crüe, signed them to Geffen; Live ?!*@ Like a Suicide came out on a fake Geffen imprint. Appetite for Destruction (1987) and Sweet Child o’ Mine hit US #1 after dates with The Cult, Crüe, and Aerosmith. Adler was replaced by Cult drummer Matt Sorum; Dizzy Reed joined on keys. Use Your Illusion I and II came out the same day, 17 September 1991, with Hanoi Rocks’ Mike Monroe on the sessions; Stradlin left and Gilby Clarke came in. Slash, McKagan, and Sorum later formed Velvet Revolver with Stone Temple Pilots’ Scott Weiland. By Oh My God (1999) Rose was the only original member left. Chinese Democracy (2008) used Buckethead, Ron “Bumblefoot” Thal, Tommy Stinson, Nine Inch Nails guitarist Robin Finck, and Reed.
body.zh:
1985 年组建。Appetite for Destruction 把 Axl Rose 的尖叫、Slash 的 Les Paul 主音、Izzy Stradlin 的节奏声部、Duff McKagan 偏朋克的贝斯、Steven Adler 的摇摆鼓，对上同期光泽 hair-metal。Use Your Illusion（1991）扩展 November Rain 等长曲，并伴随阵容紧张。

Welcome to the Jungle 与 Sweet Child O’ Mine（1987）是双入口。它们是 alternative 重画美国摇滚电台之前，硬摇滚商业晚期的峰值。

Rose（William Bailey）与 Stradlin（Jeffrey Isbell）1982 年从印第安纳搬到洛杉矶。最初是 Tracii Guns、Ole Beich、Rob Gardner，后由 Slash、Duff McKagan、Steven Adler 接替。五人首次同台是 1985 年 6 月。A&R Tom Zutaut（也经手 Mötley Crüe）把他们签进 Geffen；Live ?!*@ Like a Suicide 用一个假的 Geffen 厂牌名发行。与 The Cult、Crüe、Aerosmith 巡演后，Appetite for Destruction（1987）与 Sweet Child o’ Mine 登美国榜首。Adler 由 The Cult 鼓手 Matt Sorum 接替，Dizzy Reed 加入键盘。Use Your Illusion I 与 II 于 1991 年 9 月 17 日同日发行，Hanoi Rocks 的 Mike Monroe 参加录音；Stradlin 离队，Gilby Clarke 进入。Slash、McKagan、Sorum 后与 Stone Temple Pilots 的 Scott Weiland 组成 Velvet Revolver。到 1999 年电影曲 Oh My God 时，Rose 是唯一留下的创始成员。Chinese Democracy（2008）用了 Buckethead、Ron “Bumblefoot” Thal、Tommy Stinson、Nine Inch Nails 吉他手 Robin Finck 与 Reed。

title.en: Street blues hard rock vs hair-metal gloss
title.zh: 街头蓝调 hard rock vs hair-metal 光泽

body.en:
Appetite for Destruction (1987) sells danger and swing: Les Paul midrange leads, open chords, Axl’s scream, Adler’s behind-the-beat drums. Late-80s metal radio had been polishing mixes; GnR kept a dirtier midrange and swing feel.

Last large hard-rock commercial wave before grunge redraws US rock radio.
body.zh:
Appetite for Destruction（1987）卖危险与摇摆：Les Paul 中频主音、开放和弦、Axl 尖叫、Adler 拖拍鼓。80 年代末金属电台在抛光混音；GnR 保持更脏的中频与摇摆感。

grunge 重画美国摇滚电台前，最后一次大规模 hard-rock 商业浪潮。

title.en: Appetite five, then churn, then partial return
title.zh: Appetite 五人，然后动荡，再部分回归

body.en:
Peak lineup: Axl / Slash / Izzy / Duff / Adler. Adler exits around 1990; Izzy in 1991; Slash and Duff in the mid-1990s. During the Chinese Democracy years Axl kept the band name with other players. From 2016, the Not in This Lifetime tours return Slash and Duff with Axl.

Chronicle peak remains the Appetite five. Later casts are separate chapters under the same name.
body.zh:
巅峰阵容：Axl / Slash / Izzy / Duff / Adler。Adler 约 1990 离开；Izzy 1991；Slash 与 Duff 在 90 年代中期。Chinese Democracy 时期 Axl 用其他乐手保留乐队名。2016 年起 Not in This Lifetime 巡演让 Slash、Duff 与 Axl 同台。

编年史巅峰仍是 Appetite 五人。后来阵容是同名下的另一些章节。

title.en: Scream, Les Paul, Stones rhythm, punk bass, swing drums
title.zh: 尖叫、Les Paul、Stones 节奏、朋克贝斯、摇摆鼓

body.en:
Axl handles range and stage drama. Slash supplies pentatonic and hexatonic hooks. Izzy writes Stones-leaning rhythm parts. Duff brings punk attack on bass. Adler swings rather than playing strict metronome metal.

That chemistry is hard to recreate; later lineups show how specific the Appetite five sound was.
body.zh:
Axl 扛音域与舞台戏剧。Slash 提供五声与六声钩子。Izzy 写偏 Stones 的节奏分声部。Duff 带来朋克攻击性贝斯。Adler 摇摆，而非严格节拍器金属。

这套配合难以复刻；后来阵容可见 Appetite 五人声音有多具体。

title.en: Welcome to the Jungle: Appetite opener
title.zh: Welcome to the Jungle：Appetite 开场

body.en:
Feedback and scream entry, tight riff, Axl’s Los Angeles lyric. MTV and radio push it as the face of Appetite.

Hard-rock single form with street-report vocal and LA scene detail.
body.zh:
反馈与尖叫进入、紧 riff、Axl 的洛杉矶歌词。MTV 与电台把它推成 Appetite 的脸。

街头报告人声的 hard-rock 单曲形式，带洛杉矶现场细节。

title.en: Sweet Child: ballad that still riffs
title.zh: Sweet Child：仍在 riff 的谣曲

body.en:
Slash’s intro figure is the radio entry; the band still hits hard in the back half. It meets hair-metal ballad expectation while keeping Appetite grit.

Mass entry for listeners who never buy the full street story.
body.zh:
Slash 前奏音型是电台入口；后半仍打得很重。它满足 hair-metal 谣曲预期，同时留下 Appetite 砂砾。

从不买完整街头叙事的听众的大众入口。

title.en: Last hard-rock mass peak before alternative radio
title.zh: alternative 电台前的最后 hard-rock 大众峰值

body.en:
The Illusion double album expands epics and fractures the cast. Grunge and alternative then occupy the US rock radio space GnR held from about 1988 to 1992.

Still the citation for late-80s street hard rock that outsold many polished metal peers.

The book calls the Metallica co-headline a major metal tour, and later says the tense 1992 dates left Metallica ahead. A 2009 Rose line, via the Chinese edition: he and Slash would not work together again unless one of them died first.
body.zh:
Illusion 双专扩展长曲并撕裂阵容。随后 grunge 与 alternative 占据 GnR 约在 1988–92 持有的美国摇滚电台空间。

仍是 80 年代末街头 hard rock 的引用——销量压过许多抛光金属同辈。

书中把与 Metallica 的联合主打称为金属巡演里的大事，后文写 1992 年紧张的同台以 Metallica 占上风收场。中文版所引 Rose 2009 年的话：他与 Slash 不会再合作，除非两人中有一个先死。

note.en: June 1985 five. Guns, Beich, and Gardner were the chairs before Slash, McKagan, and Adler.
note.zh: 1985 年 6 月五人。Slash、McKagan、Adler 之前的座位是 Guns、Beich 与 Gardner。

note.en: Sorum (ex-Cult) replaced Adler. Reed on keys. Clarke replaced Stradlin after the 17 September 1991 double album. Illusion sessions include Mike Monroe of Hanoi Rocks.
note.zh: Sorum（前 Cult）接替 Adler。Reed 键盘。1991 年 9 月 17 日双专辑之后 Clarke 接替 Stradlin。Illusion 录音有 Hanoi Rocks 的 Mike Monroe。

label.zh: Not in This Lifetime 回归

note.en: Partial classic return without the full Appetite five.
note.zh: 部分经典回归，并非完整 Appetite 五人。

note.en: Street hard-rock single that reoriented late-80s metal radio.
note.zh: 重定向 80 年代末金属电台的街头 hard-rock 单曲。

note.en: Last pre-grunge hard-rock mass peak; Appetite five as the main silhouette.
note.zh: grunge 前最后 hard-rock 大众峰值；Appetite 五人是主要剪影。
